The 25–30% area rule and the 50% cost rule are contractor-consensus thresholds, and the IRC reroofing provisions in Section R908 prohibit roofing over a water-soaked deck."
findings.suggestedFix: Re-pin to the named sources exactly as the committed South Orange sibling does. The combo lumps BOTH the 25–30% area rule AND the 50% cost rule under a single 'attributed to Kellow, Modernize, and Josten guidance' citation, which mis-attributes the 50% cost rule. Per the pack: 25–30% AREA rule = RapidRestore/MyQuoteIQ/Kellow; 50% COST rule = WeatherShield; 30% COST rule = Kellow/Modernize. This is the recurring NQR contractor-blog rule-of-thumb mis-pairing.
findings.evidence: 'The 25–30% area rule and the 50% cost rule are contractor-consensus thresholds attributed to Kellow, Modernize, and Josten guidance, and a localized repair costs 5 to 10 times less than a replacement, per Home Depot and Kelly Roofing cost data.'
findings.suggestedFix: Re-pair the sources or drop the misattributed name. Before→After: '…attributed to Kellow, Modernize, and Josten guidance' → 'the 25–30% area rule a contractor-consensus threshold and the 50% cost rule attributed to WeatherShield' (or simply '…are contractor-consensus thresholds' with no name, matching the asphalt-shingle combo's clean phrasing).
findings.finalFix:
Before: "The 25–30% area rule and the 50% cost rule are contractor-consensus thresholds attributed to Kellow, Modernize, and Josten guidance, and a localized repair costs 5 to 10 times less than a replacement, per Home Depot and Kelly Roofing cost data."
After: "The 25–30% area rule traces to RapidRestore and Modernize and the 50% cost rule to WeatherShield and Home Depot, with the 30% cost rule attributed to Kellow and Modernize, and a localized repair costs 5 to 10 times less than a replacement, per Home Depot and Kelly Roofing cost data."

findings.issue: The 50% cost rule is mis-paired to Kellow/Modernize/Josten. findings.evidence: 'The 25–30% area rule and the 50% cost rule are contractor-consensus thresholds, per Kellow, Modernize, and Josten cost guidance, and a recurring leak in the same spot signals a systemic flashing failure rather than an isolated one.'
findings.suggestedFix: Attribute only the 30% rule to those sources and leave the 50% rule as general consensus: 'The 30% repair-vs-replace rule is a contractor-consensus threshold attributed to Kellow, Modernize, and Josten, and the 50% cost rule is an industry-consensus threshold; a recurring leak in the same spot signals a systemic flashing failure rather than an isolated one.'
